prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1404; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on the recording, if that's okay. You can just use the claim number.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving on a two-lane road in Pasadena, Texas, heading toward the store. It was a clear afternoon and the road was dry.
Q: What happened right before impact?
A: The other car came over into my lane. I think they were trying to pass something. I hit the brakes and steered right, but we still collided nose to nose. It wasn't very fast, maybe twenty or twenty-five miles an hour, but it was enough.
Q: Did your airbags deploy?
A: Yes, the front airbags went off. My head snapped forward and then back against the seat.
Q: Did you lose consciousness at any point?
A: I don't think so, but everything went fuzzy for a few seconds. I remember the other driver asking if I was okay.
Q: Have you been seen by a medical provider since the collision?
A: Yes, I went to the emergency room that evening. They did a CT scan and told me I had a concussion. I was told to rest and avoid screens as much as possible.
Q: How are your symptoms today?
A: Still pretty rough. I get headaches in the afternoon, I'm sensitive to light, and I get dizzy if I stand up too quickly. I've had to take time off work.
Q: Have you had any prior head injuries or concussions?
A: Not that I can recall. I played some sports in school, but nothing serious that I remember.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Just that I'm trying to follow the doctor's instructions and I'd appreciate the claim being handled as quickly as possible.
